# The AArch64 forms the lift covers, one template a line: the yaxpeax opcode an arm of
# `lift_instr` in crates/ra-asm-lift/src/arm64.rs names, then the assembly with its operands as
# classes in braces. `[name]` opens the group whose cases go to cases/<name>.cases. The writer
# (`write_arm64_cases` in crates/ra-asm-lift/tests/vectors_gen.rs) expands every class over its
# sample values, assembles the lines with llvm-mc in WSL and writes the cases; `arm64_cases`
# checks the committed cases against this file and the lift's arm list. Every opcode listed here
# has an arm, and every arm but `Invalid` (an undecodable word has no assembly) is listed.

[system]
B       b #{label}
RET     ret
RET     ret {Xn}
HINT    hint #{hint}
DMB     dmb {barrier}
DSB     dsb {barrier}
ISB     isb
SB      sb
SSBB    ssbb
PSSBB   pssbb
CLREX   clrex
PRFM    prfm pldl1keep, [{XnSP}, #{pimm8}]
PRFM    prfm pstl2strm, [{XnSP}, {Xi}, lsl #3]
PRFUM   prfum pldl1keep, [{XnSP}, #{simm9}]
PACIASP paciasp
PACIBSP pacibsp
AUTIASP autiasp
AUTIBSP autibsp
PACIAZ  paciaz
PACIBZ  pacibz
AUTIAZ  autiaz
AUTIBZ  autibz
XPACLRI xpaclri
BRK     brk #{imm16}
UDF     udf #{imm16}
HLT     hlt #{imm16}

[moves]
MOVZ    movz {Xd}, #{imm16}, lsl #{hw64}
MOVZ    movz {Wd}, #{imm16}, lsl #{hw32}
MOVN    movn {Xd}, #{imm16}, lsl #{hw64}
MOVN    movn {Wd}, #{imm16}, lsl #{hw32}
MOVK    movk {Xd}, #{imm16}, lsl #{hw64}
MOVK    movk {Wd}, #{imm16}, lsl #{hw32}

[arith]
ADD     add {XdSP}, {XnSP}, #{imm12}
ADD     add {XdSP}, {XnSP}, #{imm12}, lsl #12
ADD     add {WdSP}, {WnSP}, #{imm12}
ADD     add {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
ADD     add {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, lsl #{shift6}
ADD     add {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, lsr #{shift6}
ADD     add {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, asr #{shift6}
ADD     add {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, lsl #{shift5}
ADD     add {XdSP}, {XnSP}, {Wm}, uxtw #{imm3}
ADD     add {XdSP}, {XnSP}, {Wm}, sxtw #{imm3}
ADD     add {XdSP}, {XnSP}, {Xm}, sxtx #{imm3}
ADD     add {WdSP}, {WnSP}, {Wm}, uxtb #{imm3}
ADD     add {WdSP}, {WnSP}, {Wm}, sxth #{imm3}
ADDS    adds {Xd}, {XnSP}, #{imm12}
ADDS    adds {Wd}, {WnSP}, #{imm12}, lsl #12
ADDS    adds {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, lsl #{shift6}
ADDS    adds {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}
ADDS    adds {Xd}, {XnSP}, {Wm}, uxtw #{imm3}
SUB     sub {XdSP}, {XnSP}, #{imm12}
SUB     sub {XdSP}, {XnSP}, #{imm12}, lsl #12
SUB     sub {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, asr #{shift5}
SUB     sub {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, lsl #{shift6}
SUB     sub {XdSP}, {XnSP}, {Wm}, uxtw #{imm3}
SUBS    subs {Xd}, {XnSP}, #{imm12}
SUBS    subs {Wd}, {WnSP}, #{imm12}, lsl #12
SUBS    subs {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
SUBS    subs {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, lsr #{shift6}
SUBS    subs {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, lsl #{shift5}
SUBS    subs {Xd}, {XnSP}, {Wm}, sxtw #{imm3}
ADC     adc {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
ADC     adc {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}
ADCS    adcs {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
ADCS    adcs {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}
SBC     sbc {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
SBC     sbc {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}
SBCS    sbcs {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
SBCS    sbcs {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}

[logic]
AND     and {XdSP}, {Xn}, #{bimm64}
AND     and {WdSP}, {Wn}, #{bimm32}
AND     and {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
AND     and {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, lsl #{shift6}
AND     and {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, lsr #{shift6}
AND     and {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, asr #{shift6}
AND     and {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, ror #{shift6}
AND     and {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, ror #{shift5}
ANDS    ands {Xd}, {Xn}, #{bimm64}
ANDS    ands {Wd}, {Wn}, #{bimm32}
ANDS    ands {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, lsr #{shift6}
ANDS    ands {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}
ORR     orr {XdSP}, {Xn}, #{bimm64}
ORR     orr {WdSP}, {Wn}, #{bimm32}
ORR     orr {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
ORR     orr {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, lsl #{shift6}
ORR     orr {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, ror #{shift5}
ORN     orn {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
ORN     orn {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, lsl #{shift5}
EOR     eor {XdSP}, {Xn}, #{bimm64}
EOR     eor {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}
EOR     eor {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, ror #{shift6}
EON     eon {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
EON     eon {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, asr #{shift5}
BIC     bic {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
BIC     bic {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, lsl #{shift5}
BICS    bics {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, lsr #{shift6}
BICS    bics {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}

[bitfield]
SBFM    sbfm {Xd}, {Xn}, #{immr64}, #{imms64}
SBFM    sbfm {Wd}, {Wn}, #{immr32}, #{imms32}
UBFM    ubfm {Xd}, {Xn}, #{immr64}, #{imms64}
UBFM    ubfm {Wd}, {Wn}, #{immr32}, #{imms32}
BFM     bfm {Xd}, {Xn}, #{immr64}, #{imms64}
BFM     bfm {Wd}, {Wn}, #{immr32}, #{imms32}
EXTR    extr {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, #{shift6}
EXTR    extr {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, #{shift5}

[shift]
LSLV    lsl {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
LSLV    lsl {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}
LSRV    lsr {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
LSRV    lsr {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}
ASRV    asr {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
ASRV    asr {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}
RORV    ror {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
RORV    ror {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}

[select]
CSEL    csel {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, {cond}
CSEL    csel {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, {cond}
CSINC   csinc {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, {cond}
CSINC   csinc {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, {cond}
CSINV   csinv {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, {cond}
CSINV   csinv {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, {cond}
CSNEG   csneg {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, {cond}
CSNEG   csneg {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, {cond}
CCMP    ccmp {Xn}, {Xm}, #{nzcv}, {cond}
CCMP    ccmp {Wn}, #{imm5}, #{nzcv}, {cond}
CCMN    ccmn {Xn}, {Xm}, #{nzcv}, {cond}
CCMN    ccmn {Wn}, #{imm5}, #{nzcv}, {cond}

[muldiv]
MADD    madd {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, {Xa}
MADD    madd {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, {Wa}
MSUB    msub {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}, {Xa}
MSUB    msub {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, {Wa}
SMADDL  smaddl {Xd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, {Xa}
SMSUBL  smsubl {Xd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, {Xa}
UMADDL  umaddl {Xd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, {Xa}
UMSUBL  umsubl {Xd}, {Wn}, {Wm}, {Xa}
SMULH   smulh {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
UMULH   umulh {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
UDIV    udiv {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
UDIV    udiv {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}
SDIV    sdiv {Xd}, {Xn}, {Xm}
SDIV    sdiv {Wd}, {Wn}, {Wm}

[bits]
CLZ     clz {Xd}, {Xn}
CLZ     clz {Wd}, {Wn}
CLS     cls {Xd}, {Xn}
CLS     cls {Wd}, {Wn}
RBIT    rbit {Xd}, {Xn}
RBIT    rbit {Wd}, {Wn}
REV     rev {Xd}, {Xn}
REV     rev {Wd}, {Wn}
REV16   rev16 {Xd}, {Xn}
REV16   rev16 {Wd}, {Wn}
REV32   rev32 {Xd}, {Xn}

[branch]
ADR     adr {Xd}, #{adr}
ADRP    adrp {Xd}, #{adrp}
BL      bl #{label}
BLR     blr {Xi}
BR      br {Xi}
Bcc     b.{cond} #{label}
BCcc    bc.{cond} #{label}
CBZ     cbz {Xd}, #{label}
CBZ     cbz {Wd}, #{label}
CBNZ    cbnz {Xd}, #{label}
CBNZ    cbnz {Wd}, #{label}

TBZ     tbz {Wd}, #{bit32}, #{label}
TBNZ    tbnz {Xd}, #{bit64}, #{label}
TBNZ    tbnz {Wd}, #{bit32}, #{label}

[loads]

LDRB    ldrb {Wd}, [{XnSP}], #{simm9}

[stores]

[pairs]
